headlines.title: Cadence Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on AI Demand, Outlook Raised
headlines.summary: CDNS beats Q3 earnings estimates as AI-driven demand fuels 22% revenue growth, record backlog and a raised full-year outlook.

headlines.title: CDNS Q3 deep dive: AI-driven design momentum offsets margin pressure
headlines.summary: Electronic design automation company Cadence Design Systems (NASDAQ:CDNS) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with sales up 22% year on year to $1.63 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $6.40 billion at the midpoint came in 1.3% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.11 per share was 2.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

headlines.title: Cadence Q3 Earnings Call Highlights AI Expansion and Higher Outlook
headlines.summary: Cadence raises its 2026 outlook as AI adoption accelerates, agentic design tools gain traction, and a record backlog reflects expanding customer demand.

headlines.title: Cadence Design Systems (NASDAQ:CDNS) Reports 22% Q3 Revenue Growth, Raises 2026 Guidance as Shares Advance Premarket
headlines.summary: Cadence Design Systems (NASDAQ:CDNS) shares advanced in premarket trading on Tuesday after the chip-design software company reported third-quarter earnings and revenue above analyst expectations and increased its full-year 2026 financial guidance. The stock traded at $329.

headlines.title: Cadence Design Systems (CDNS) Unveiled Maestro AI Model Portfolio For AI Super Agents
headlines.summary: Cadence Design Systems (NasdaqGS:CDNS) announced its Maestro AI Model Portfolio for AI Super Agents in semiconductor and system design workflows. The Maestro platform combines large language models, reinforcement learning and Cadence EDA and SDA tools into a single agentic engineering environment. Early users report measurable gains in engineering efficiency and design quality from applying Maestro AI agents to complex project workflows.

description: Cadence Design Systems, Inc. develops computational, AI-driven software, hardware, and silicon intellectual property products and solutions. The company offers functional verification services, such as Jasper, a formal verification platform; Xcelium, a parallel logic simulation platform; Verisium, a generative AI solution; Palladium, an enterprise emulation platform; and Protium, a prototyping platform for chip verification, as well as digital IC design and sign off products, including Innovus platform; and custom IC design and simulation product include Virtuoso, a platform to design and verify analog. It also provides Xcelium logic simulator and other front-end verification and virtual prototyping technologies; controllers and physical interfaces; PCI Express, universal accelerator and compute express links, and multiple memory interfaces; and Tensilica, a digital signal processor. In addition, the company's design IP portfolio includes serializer/deserializer, peripheral component interconnect, USB, and other standard protocols; and Secure-IC, a solution for embedded security IP. Additionally, it provides System Design and Analysis (SD&A) platform, a solution that enables end-to-end system-level design and verification across chips, packages, PCBs, and electronic systems; Allegro X and Orca X platforms for PCB and advanced packaging; Sigrity X for signal and power integrity; AIR for RF design; Fidelity for computational fluid dynamics; Celsius for thermal and airflow analysis; Clarity 3D solver for electromagnetic and power electronics analysis and simulation; Integrity 3D-IC solution for 3D-IC and multi-chiplet designs; the Optimality Intelligent System Explorer, Reality digital twin, and Millennium enterprise multiphasic platforms; Allegro system design platform; and molecular modeling and simulation solutions and services. The company has a strategic collaboration with NVIDIA. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
